_comment: T-349 Syndicate street tier, WAVE 1. The law that's half on the take — a HUMAN on the T-118 hero rig (entity_visuals maps mob_constable_take -> char_hero_warrior.glb with a navy-uniform tint). Disciplined melee: mid HP, faster/steadier swing than the legbreaker, a little dodge. Truncheon prop cosmetic-deferred. The 'whistle add-call' (ashmoor-direction.md S4, the T-294 summon shape) is DEFERRED: boss_mechanics/summons are resolved only for INSTANCE-scoped mobs by instance_service.tick_bosses; an OPEN-WORLD (instance_id 0) summon tick does not exist and wiring one is new server logic outside this ticket's no-new-netcode scope. Ships as solid melee; whistle logged for a follow-on. L20-24 band.
name: Constable on the Take
